problem: Build 10 moved onto furniture with the ordinary walk atlas and only 0.01 cat widths of cushion elevation, creating a slide through the visible cushion side.
changes: Dedicated eight-pose step atlas: reach, forepaw support pause, hind-leg push, stable support, and separate step-down poses
Entry prefers a safe diagonal and keeps its actual facing through settling; constrained centered fallback turns to the selected facing before entry
Cushion support elevation increased from 0.01 to 0.14 cat widths; bed resting registration retained
Ground movement is staged around paw support; front-leg mesh adapts to the surface height while head and body scale stay stable
Surface shadow follows the support height; standing-to-lying registration is released continuously
An unfinished climb reverses the attained poses at its current position and height before any feeding or layout action
Diagnostics use actual source paw landmarks and runtime mesh transforms; interruption records the phase when input actually arrives
Bed foreground rim appears only after full support; it cannot slice across a partially entering or exiting cat.

pawGeometry.scope: Numerical source-landmark and mesh audit, not a replacement for rendered-frame review

initialFailure.finding: The new test moved a cushion behind the standing cat and tapped the cat instead; video shows the cat-profile sheet. No climb occurred.
initialFailure.correction: Only this test fixture moved to an unobstructed floor position; product hit testing and interruption/clearance assertions were not relaxed.

visualReview.method: Actual simulator recording extracted at 0.2-second intervals; root and independent agent reviewed the rendered paws, torso, rim and supported pose.
visualReview.finding: Front paws reach the near rim while rear paws remain on the floor; rear legs follow over the edge, then the cat settles on the surface. The reviewed entry no longer uses a flat walk through the cushion side.
visualReview.scope: Cushion ascent; before the bed-only rim correction. Dedicated post-correction bed review is recorded separately.

limits: New motion still awaits user acceptance on the physical iPhone
This remains a 2D sprite animation, not a skeletal or 3D rig
Full lifecycle/reduced-motion matrix and long-session physical performance were not run in this pass

bedRimReview.initialResult: failed rendered-frame review despite passing functional test
bedRimReview.finding: The foreground bed rim covered the chest while the cat was still entering from the floor.
bedRimReview.correction: Draw the cropped front rim only during the supported phase, after all paws reach the mattress; hide during entry and step-down.
bedRimReview.finalResult: passed for reviewed final entry, supported rest, wake stretch and step-down frames
bedRimReview.method: Final Pro simulator recording; root and independent agent reviewed actual rendered frames.
bedRimReview.findingAfterFix: The foreground rim no longer crosses the chest or abdomen during ascent; the wake stretch stays above the near edge and step-down clears the floor. This is a visual frame review, not a claim of 3D physical simulation.
